walkthroughReviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat), a different agent from the author
author: Codex documentation author
frontend: Working documentation preview at 127.0.0.1:43333 over the immutable configuration backend at 127.0.0.1:43332
browser: Playwright 1.62.1 Chromium from the workspace, headless, one isolated context per identity; scripts written by the reviewer from the article text

steps.action: Wrong password gives the article's visible error, and the correct one still works
steps.actual: The app answered "Check your email and password." and stayed on the sign-in page, which is the visible error the article tells the reader to give an Administrator. No account lockout followed and the correct password signed in on the next attempt.

steps.action: A used Portal sign-in link is refused and a fresh link is the documented recovery
steps.actual: The first use of the link signed in at /portal. Opening the same link again was refused with the app's expired/already-used wording, so "request a new link and open the newest message" is the actual recovery. The link itself is kept out of this record.

steps.action: A Confidential Contract answers the article's generic refusal, not a hint that it exists
steps.actual: As a Contributor with no team entry, C-55 showed "Something went wrong." with a Reload control and no record title. Reloading again did not change access, exactly as the article says. Nothing in the article offered a way around the refusal.

steps.action: The article's escalation works: the Administrator adds the team entry the Contributor needs
steps.actual: Following the article's escalation, the Administrator added Ravi Menon as a Contributor team entry on C-55. This is fixture preparation performed as the person the article names, not a reader instruction.

steps.action: Reload after the team entry reaches the same record
steps.actual: With the qualifying team entry the same direct link opened C-55 "Docs V-C49 confidential access review". The recovery the article names is the one that worked; the refusal was access, not deletion.

steps.action: A Contributor cannot open the Entities module, so a linked record grants nothing
steps.actual: The Entities module did not open for the Contributor and its navigation entry is absent, which supports the reference statement that Confidential Entities need their own arrangement and that a Contract team entry gives no Entity access.

steps.action: Legal-managed actions the article lists are absent for a Contributor on shared work
steps.actual: On the shared Contract the Contributor had no Add approver, no Apply group and no Add task control (approvals surface read: "Legal-managed details are read-only. You can edit the business Fields available to you. Approvals & signing 0 No approva"). The article's instruction to ask Legal to perform the legal action is the only route the app leaves open.

fixturePreparation: Created two fictional Contracts as the Legal Team Member through the API: C-55 "Docs V-C49 confidential access review" (Confidential) and C-56 "Docs V-C49 upload and approval review".
Added the Contributor team entry as the Administrator, which is the person the troubleshooting article names for that escalation.
limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Signing and Analysis remain unconfigured in this lab. Their checks record an unconfigured connector, which is not evidence that any live provider works.
